title: One owner for each piece of state

slides.say: For each piece of state, one specific component owns it. That is a single source of truth.

slides.text: Not one place for ALL state. One owner for EACH piece.
slides.say: It does not mean all state lives in one place. Input state can live near the leaves. A current route can live near the top.

slides.text: Don’t duplicate shared state. Lift it up, pass it down.
slides.say: When two components need the same state, do not duplicate it. Lift it to the common parent and pass it down.

slides.text: Moving state up or down while you build is normal.
slides.say: And it is normal to move state up or down as your app changes. That is part of the process.
